title: 05.04 - What a contribution ID is
intent: Define the contribution ID and explain why it is useful.
short_answer: The contribution ID is the individual number automatically generated for your submitted answer. It is a unique identifier that allows EUSurvey to recognise your contribution.
procedure: After submitting your contribution, check the Confirmation page.
Note or save the contribution ID displayed there.
If you save or receive a PDF copy, check the upper-left side of the PDF for the contribution ID.
Use the contribution ID when contacting EUSurvey support or the survey organisers about your contribution.
important_conditions: The contribution ID is unique to your contribution.
It is useful for support requests and for actions related to your submitted answers.
